editorial.blurb: Birriería y Taquería El Arandas serves made-from-scratch Mexican food with house-made tortillas and salsas that transport you straight to Mexico.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during off-peak hours (like early afternoon) to avoid long waits for service and bills; the homemade salsa and birria broth are worth the visit, but dip your house-made tortillas in the consomé.

topDishes.note: dipped in consomé with cilantro and onion, made with house-made tortillas
not greasy, served with house-made tortillas and fresh lime
